breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's erroneous instruction to use the polar second moment (J) in the curvature relation. Instead, it used the correct formula for beam bending curvature, κ = M / (E × I), which aligns with the ground truth prompt.
